extracted.name: Oh-So-Good Chicken
extracted.description: Mexican-style seasonings and cooked mushrooms make this oh-so-good chicken and rice casserole recipe a tasty version of the family-friendly favorite.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces boneless chicken breast halves, cooked and diced
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms; cook and stir.
Combine mushrooms, rice, salsa, chicken, Cheddar cheese, and sour cream in a bowl; transfer to a greased casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 35 minutes.
